report.clinical_summary: Patient with a five-year history of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) in watch-and-wait status presents with new symptoms including fatigue, night sweats, and neck tension that began two months ago. The symptoms are significantly impacting their ability to work and are causing considerable worry and a sense of loss of control. The patient is seeking answers through physical examination and blood work to understand the cause of these new developments.
